title: Controls that wear with use
blurb: A <button> whose paint chips where it's pressed, a key that sinks and keeps fingerprints, and a slider whose track wears a groove where the thumb has been. The wear is kept in plain canvases and composited with each element's own picture.
question: Can a canvas cut holes in a native control's picture and draw marks on it that build up with every press, while the control stays a button?
result: Yes, in 2D. destination-out with a plain canvas of chips cuts the picture, destination-over fills the holes, and source-atop keeps prints on the surface. The hit box doesn't change.
